question: Among living patients whose last names begin with "A" and who each have exactly one distinct condition, which eight conditions have the highest number of different active medications prescribed to any single patient, and what are their corresponding codes?
sql:
WITH living_patients AS (
  SELECT p.id as patient_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient` p
  WHERE p.deceased.dateTime IS NULL
),
patients_with_one_condition AS (
  SELECT c.subject.patientId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
  GROUP BY c.subject.patientId
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) = 1
),
filtered_patients AS (
  SELECT lp.patient_id
  FROM living_patients lp
  JOIN patients_with_one_condition poc ON lp.patient_id = poc.patientId
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient` p ON lp.patient_id = p.id
  WHERE p.name[OFFSET(0)].family LIKE 'A%'
),
patient_conditions AS (
  SELECT fp.patient_id, c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code as condition_code, c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].display as condition_display
  FROM filtered_patients fp
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c ON fp.patient_id = c.subject.patientId
),
patient_meds AS (
  SELECT fp.patient_id, mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[OFFSET(0)].code as med_code
  FROM filtered_patients fp
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request` mr ON fp.patient_id = mr.subject.patientId
  WHERE mr.status = 'active'
  GROUP BY fp.patient_id, mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[OFFSET(0)].code
),
meds_count_per_patient AS (
  SELECT pc.patient_id, pc.condition_code, pc.condition_display, pm.med_code,
         COUNT(DISTINCT pm.med_code) OVER (PARTITION BY pc.patient_id, pc.condition_code) as num_meds
  FROM patient_conditions pc
  JOIN patient_meds pm ON pc.patient_id = pm.patient_id
),
max_meds_per_condition AS (
  SELECT condition_code, condition_display, MAX(num_meds) as max_meds
  FROM meds_count_per_patient
  GROUP BY condition_code, condition_display
)
SELECT condition_code, condition_display, max_meds
FROM max_meds_per_condition
ORDER BY max_meds DESC, condition_code ASC
LIMIT 8
